description: Four quantisers that snap incoming pitches to the tuning and temperament set in the Tracker

params.text: Shifts that row's output by whole octaves, -4 to +4

inputs.text: The pitch to be quantised on that row; a polyphonic cable is quantised channel by channel

outputs.text: That row's pitch snapped to the track's tuning, shifted by the track's reference offset and by that row's OCT knob

notes: nothing comes out of this until a Tracker module is somewhere in the patch; the two are joined through the plugin rather than by a cable, so where it goes in the rack does not matter.
this is for quantising modules outside the suite; what the Tracker's own modules put out is already in the track's tuning.
menu: Mode 1: Index down, Index up, Index round, Nearest — sets how the first row picks a note: by its place in the tuning table rounded down, up or to nearest, or by nearest pitch
Mode 2: Index down, Index up, Index round, Nearest — sets how the second row picks a note: by its place in the tuning table rounded down, up or to nearest, or by nearest pitch
Mode 3: Index down, Index up, Index round, Nearest — sets how the third row picks a note: by its place in the tuning table rounded down, up or to nearest, or by nearest pitch
Mode 4: Index down, Index up, Index round, Nearest — sets how the fourth row picks a note: by its place in the tuning table rounded down, up or to nearest, or by nearest pitch
